The problem

Sound familiar?

Revenue cycle issues surface weeks late

Denials, aging AR, and underpayments are usually discovered a full billing cycle after they happened.

No-shows disrupt the whole schedule

Providers lose productive time to missed appointments, with no early visibility into who's actually at risk.

Patients quietly stop coming back

Panels keep growing on paper, but it's unclear how many existing patients have silently churned.

Reporting means pulling from everywhere

EHR, billing, and scheduling data all live in separate systems that someone has to manually reconcile.

The shift

From guesswork to a live dashboard

Before Scape

  • AR and denial issues found a billing cycle late
  • No-show risk invisible until the seat is empty
  • Patient churn tracked informally, if at all
  • Reports assembled by hand from 3+ systems

With Scape

  • Revenue cycle leakage flagged as it happens
  • At-risk appointments surfaced before they're missed
  • Panel growth measured net of quiet churn
  • One live dashboard, sourced automatically
